title: Here Are the 2 Big Things We're Watching in This Week's Stock Market: FOMC Decision and AI Selloff
summary: The Federal Reserve's September 15–16 FOMC meeting kicks off Tuesday with Wednesday's rate decision the week's central event. Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish August 28 Jackson Hole speech left markets pricing a 25bp hike to 3.75%–4.00% as the most likely outcome. Simultaneously, AI-pacing concerns continued to drag semiconductor stocks, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling 5.9% on Monday September 14, the Nasdaq dropping 0.8%, and the S&P 500 slipping 0.5%.
why: FOMC加息决议明日（9/16 02:00 ET）揭晓，若落地则科技/成长估值承压；半导体指数单日重挫5.9%为期权持仓者提供加保护思考契机；沃什新闻发布会措辞将是关键风险信号。

title: Z.ai Shares Tumble Over 10% After $5 Billion Fundraising, Its Second Major Raise in Two Months
summary: China's AI company Z.AI (2513.HK) announced plans to raise ~HK$39.27 billion ($5 billion) through a share placement of 22 million new H shares at HK$714 each (a 9.96% discount to the closing price of HK$793) plus zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2027. Shares fell more than 10% on Monday September 14. This follows a $4 billion placement in July, making Z.AI one of Hong Kong's most active AI fundraisers in 2026.
why: 港股AI独角兽高折价大规模配股+零息可转债组合拖累当日恒生科技指数；稀释压力短期压制估值，但也反映香港AI融资热情持续旺盛；期权隐含波动率在此类事件后通常放大，是观察港股AI板块定价修复机会的时间窗口。

title: Circle's USD400M Tazapay Deal Buys Emerging-Market Links That Take Years to Build
summary: Circle (CRCL) agreed to acquire Singapore-based B2B cross-border payments platform Tazapay for $400 million in an all-stock transaction. Tazapay brings over $25 billion in annualized payment volume, 60+ banking and fintech partners, and local payout rails covering 100+ markets—extending Circle's USDC network into emerging markets at scale. Deal expected to close in 2027 pending regulatory approvals including the Monetary Authority of Singapore.
why: Circle以$400M全股票对价将USDC支付触角延伸至100+新兴市场，是USDC商业化的里程碑事件；Arc主网预计9月16日上线为近期另一催化剂；持有CRCL头寸者可关注Tazapay整合进度及CLARITY Act参议院投票时间线。
